name: Garden Nook (Base Game)
author: HoldenRoark
style: Single-storey powder-blue painted-brick cottage on a brick plinth: a clay-tile swoop skillion rising west to a white outrigger post meets a pale-gabled clay front gable in a V; string-lit porch of white column trios on a raised timber deck, recessed kitchen loggia, glass garden nook and a stucco chimney; gravel S-curve between curbed hydrangea and hibiscus beds, slatted rear pergola deck and a round flagstone hot-tub terrace
